summary: The filing is an 8-K by Liftoff Mobile, Inc. reporting its IPO on June 3, 2026. It details the entry into a Registration Rights Agreement, and Stockholders Agreements with Blackstone and General Atlantic, along with the adoption of a 2026 Omnibus Incentive Plan and related charter amendments. The report covers the IPO closing, stockholder rights changes, and compensatory arrangements. No explicit deal terms are specified; the only event is the IPO itself, which is a routine capital-raising transaction.
